faq.q: How is a titanium embolization coil mandrel manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium embolization coil mandrel is manufactured using Laser micro-cutting; Shape-setting heat treatment; Electropolishing. BOZE CNC Ti uses precision CNC equipment with strict process controls to ensure consistent quality and dimensional accuracy.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Nitinol (ASTM F2063) for titanium embolization coil mandrel?
faq.a: Alternative materials include stainless steel (heavier, susceptible to corrosion) and aluminum (lower strength, shorter fatigue life). The alternative manufacturing method is Conventional machining (higher material waste, longer cycle time).

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium embolization coil mandrel?
faq.a: Titanium Embolization Coil Mandrel components are typically manufactured to ASTM B348. Additional customer-specific specifications may apply.
